act_descr: Act I — Launch, Leverage, and Leaks
chapters: Midtown corridor hop. Eli lands the municipal pilot counsel gig; Priya frames “tight scope.” He clocks Sasha’s “contextual improvement” spin.

Greenpoint vendor suddenly in the path. Noor patches, sees cross-tenant trace IDs she can’t unsee.
- Interlude: #growth-expansion standup. Redacted. Sasha pushes “silent uplift week.” Victor demands vendor throughput. A stray snippet: “DV shelter” tag.
“Don’t let expansion bleed into pilot.”
DUMBO war room. Beta-customer wall covered in anonymized quotes; one is not anonymized. Noor flags to Priya; Priya asks for “email only” and toggles legal hold on a narrow bucket.

“We don’t disclose architecture.” Eli marks the first crack.
- Interlude: incident-bridge channel. Jules posts AWS flow logs. A domestic-violence nonprofit slug appears in a city pilot account. “Silence until we scope.” Victor sets a 2 a.m. war room.
“We’ll revisit post-Series C.”
“If sealed case names leak, it’s a state offense.” Eli drafts a side letter; Priya redlines it into mush.
Greenpoint labeling studio. Noor spots TaskWeave screens mirrored at contractor stations. A worker says, “They said it’s synthetic.” Noor pockets a schedule printout.

act_descr: Act II — The Pilot, The Pitch, and The Price
chapters:
Cornell Tech onsite. Amaya runs a test; Smart Canvas autocompletes a sealed juvenile name. Room goes white. Eli freezes the session, calls for data provenance. Victor calls it “cache hallucination.”
- Interlude: Founder office hours. Ava scripts talking points: “Contextual improvement ≠ training.” Slack thread captured and partially redacted. Warrant canary line quietly removed from the policy.
midnight hotfix rerouted transcripts, tenant boundary off by one misconfigured ARN. Priya asks them not to put it in writing.
City Hall pre-brief. Amaya threatens FOIL if model cards aren’t delivered. Eli urges controlled disclosure; Ava offers “confidence memo” instead.
North Williamsburg ferry. Noor confesses the bleed to Eli. Chemistry with caution. He lays out protected disclosures; she names the Greenpoint vendor.

1 Vanderbilt pitch. Rohan floats a term sheet with data-audit contingencies. Victor counters with MAU fireworks. Eli watches the board choose optics.
- Interlude: late-night incident channel. “Stability patch 2.” Sasha orders a silent schema shift. Jules: “We’re writing over evidence.” Noor screenshots, encrypts, stashes with Zara.
LIC colo facility. Noor verifies old snapshots exist. Facility guard recognizes her from the launch stream. She pulls a hashed manifest; someone else is already querying.
Boutique firm conflict wall. Victor calls Eli “off the matter” after he insists on a hold-to-preserve across vendors. Priya privately asks him to keep advising “informally.”
Jules preserves logs; Amaya triggers FOIL; Eli drafts a narrow disclosure path.

“Consent decree expansion.” He realizes time is a vise.
- Interlude: #growth-expansion deck drop. Slides promise “On-device modes.” Notes in margins: “Ship a dummy toggle.” Someone replies with a thumbs-up emoji and a broom.

act_descr: Act III — Exposure, Choice, and Consequence
chapters: City Hall hearing. Amaya introduces anonymized outputs showing sealed names. Ava blames a “sandbox bug.” Noor forwards the model-card draft to Amaya from a ferry bench.
Roosevelt Island back room. Eli coordinates lawful preservation with the municipal IG. He and Noor share a quiet, charged minute—no promises, just resolve.

Union Square showdown. Victor tries to barter Noor’s I‑140 for silence. She refuses, pushes a signed letter to HR asserting protected activity. Priya looks like she might finally pick a side.
- Interlude: All-hands Slack. “We are pausing Smart Canvas features to improve safety.” Comment storm. Jules posts a resignation emoji; dozens DM him for the receipts.
offers to fund a cleanup if leadership turns over. Ava smiles for cameras; her DMs beg Victor to find “a scapegoat path.”
Greenpoint raid—paper only. Noor, Jules, and Amaya collect labeling SOPs and workstation screenshots under vendor consent. The “synthetic” line collapses.

250 Broadway final hearing. Priya produces the model cards and a timeline. Victor takes the fall publicly; Ava keeps her seat by a vote. Consent decree incoming. Series C “restructures” into a bridge with audit triggers.
Pier 17, quiet morning. Noor resigns with severance that doesn’t gag her. Releases a technical blog—sterile, exact—on building trustworthy model boundaries. It trends anyway.

Park bench above the East River. Eli leaves the firm to start a small data-rights clinic. He texts Noor a photo of the empty consent toggle—now real, because it must be.
- Coda (Both): Night ferry from DUMBO to Pier 11. City lit, Con Ed stacks blinking. They sit side by side, phones face down. Trust is small and chosen, not promised. The water keeps their secrets, for now.
